test_title: PYST 38: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The child ______ that he had broken the vase.
solution:
The correct answer is **admitted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Admit**: to agree that something unpleasant is true or that someone has done something wrong.

 
 
• **Example:** Rohan **admitted** that he had stolen the pen. 
 
 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Collect: **to bring a number of things together.
 
• **Demand: **a strong request or order that must be obeyed.
 
• **Request: **an act of asking for something.
